title: Database Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Database Engineer / SQL Developer with hands\-on experience in database administration, SQL development, database migration, ETL/ELT, performance tuning, and production support.

Required Skills

* 5\+ years of experience in DBA, SQL Development, or Database Engineering
* Strong knowledge of SQL and database concepts
* Experience with one or more databases: MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL
* Strong experience in complex SQL queries, Stored Procedures, Functions, Views, and Triggers
* Hands\-on experience in Database / Data Migration
* Experience with ETL/ELT, data transformation, validation, and reconciliation
* Good understanding of query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning
* Knowledge of Backup \& Restore and database troubleshooting
* Experience in production database support
* Experience with AWS / Azure databases is preferred
* Experience with SSIS, AWS DMS, Azure Data Factory, or similar ETL/migration tools is an advantage

Preferred Skills

* Cross\-platform database migration
* On\-premise to Cloud migration
* Experience handling large\-volume data migration
* Exposure to multiple database technologies
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Good communication and documentation skills

Pay: ₹368,798\.45 \- ₹1,504,400\.30 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Process Manager
description:
**Core Responsibilities** :


Database Management: Oversee all aspects of database management, including installation, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of SQL Server environments (e.g., versions 2012\-2019 and beyond).  



Performance Tuning \& Optimization: Lead efforts in complex performance analysis and tuning, optimizing inefficient queries, and managing data models to ensure maximum system efficiency and stability.  



High Availability \& Disaster Recovery: Design, implement, and administer high availability solutions (e.g., Always On, replication, mirroring) and comprehensive backup/restore strategies to ensure data integrity and minimal downtime.  



Security \& Compliance: Define and enforce security policies, create and manage user permissions and roles, and mitigate security risks to protect sensitive data.  



Cloud Integration \& Migration: Drive database migration projects and manage database solutions on cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.


Automation \& Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for automation to increase team productivity and develop documentation for policies, procedures, and standards.  



Technical Leadership \& Mentorship: Provide technical guidance, leadership, and potentially oversee a team of DBAs, collaborating with developers, analysts, and project managers.  



Required Skills \& Experience  



15\+ years of experience in SQL Server Database Administration and development.


Expert proficiency in SQL, stored procedures, and query optimization.


Hands\-on expertise with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), data modeling, and architecture.


Extensive experience with operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and cloud technologies.


Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to identify root causes of production issues.


Excellent communication skills for collaborating with stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.

title: Senior Oracle Database Adminstation Engineer
description:
### **Job Description**


### **Company Details**



Oracle provides cloud technology, database solutions, and enterprise applications that help organizations run critical business operations securely and reliably.


### **CSS Team Details**



The Customer Success Services (CSS) team supports Oracle customers in managing and maintaining business\-critical systems. The team works closely with customers to provide technical support, resolve production issues, improve database performance, and maintain high availability across Oracle environments.


### **Mandatory Skills**


* 6–15 years of experience as an Oracle DBA or Database Engineer in production environments
* Strong experience in Oracle Database administration and troubleshooting
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Exadata architecture and administration
* Strong knowledge of Oracle RAC and ASM
* Experience in Oracle database performance tuning and troubleshooting
* Hands\-on experience with Data Guard, including Physical Standby, Active Data Guard, and Data Guard Broker
* Strong RMAN backup, restore, and recovery experience, including critical recovery scenarios
* Experience with database installation, upgrades, migration, and patching
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues related to performance, availability, RAC/ASM, backup and recovery, and patching
* Ability to handle critical production incidents under pressure
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Customer\-focused service and support mindset
* Willingness to work shifts and weekends when required

### **Good\-to\-Have Skills**


* Oracle GoldenGate replication and troubleshooting
* ZDLRA administration or support
* Logical Data Guard experience
* Experience resolving Exadata\-specific performance or patching issues
* Experience supporting large, highly available Oracle database environments
* Oracle Database, Exadata, or other relevant technical certifications

### **Roles and Responsibilities**


* Manage, monitor, and maintain Oracle databases in production environments.
* Support Oracle Exadata, RAC, ASM, Data Guard, and RMAN environments.
* Investigate and resolve database performance, availability, backup, recovery, and patching issues.
* Perform database installation, upgrades, migration, and patching activities.
* Handle critical production incidents and provide timely updates to customers and internal teams.
* Perform backup and recovery activities, including complex recovery situations.
* Monitor database health and recommend improvements for performance, availability, and reliability.
* Work with customers, support teams, and engineering teams to resolve technical issues.
* Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and incident reports.
* Participate in shift, weekend, and on\-call support as needed.

### **Qualifications**



Career Level \- IC3


### **About Us**



Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.



True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. title: MS Engineer L2, DBA MySQL, Postgress
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you will play an essential role in maintaining our clients' IT infrastructure and systems. Your expertise will help keep everything running smoothly by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll be the go\-to person to restore services and ensure our clients' satisfaction.  

  

Your typical day involves managing work queues, addressing incidents and requests within agreed SLAs, and updating tickets with the actions taken. By identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate, you'll be instrumental in maintaining service quality. You'll also collaborate closely with other teams and clients to provide second\-level support, ensuring seamless communication and efficient problem resolution.  

  

You will execute changes meticulously, understanding and mitigating risks, and contribute to the change management process with detailed documentation. Your role includes auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and identifying tasks for automation to enhance efficiency. Additionally, you'll handle client escalations with professionalism and assist in disaster recovery functions and tests when necessary.  

  

Working within our diverse and inclusive environment, you'll help drive the optimization of efforts by working with automation teams and supporting L1 Engineers. Your responsibility also extends to contributing to various projects, ensuring that all changes are approved, and maintaining a positive outlook even in high\-pressure situations.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Moderate\-level experience in managed services roles handling cross\-technology infrastructure.
* Knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and experience working with vendors and third parties.
* Proficiency in planning activities and projects, taking changing circumstances into account.
* Ability to work longer hours when necessary and adapt to changing circumstances with ease.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Positive outlook and ability to work well under pressure.
* Commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and ensuring a positive experience.
* Bachelor's degree in IT/Computing or equivalent work experience.
